title: 最坏要赔1.4万亿：Meta却只掏167亿，股价为何不跌反涨？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Breaking news, meta has agreed to a $16.7 billion settlement in its teen social media harm case. The stock is up nearly 4% on the news. Let's bring back Bloomberg tech host
segments.zh: 突发新闻，Meta已同意就青少年社交媒体伤害案达成167亿美元和解。消息公布后，股价上涨近4%。让我们连线彭博科技主持人

segments.en: Ed Ludlow. And we're just on two moments ago before this. We have a price tag on the settlement, just how big of a relief of a savings is this for meta versus if they had gone to trial.
segments.zh: Ed Ludlow。我们刚刚在几分钟前还在讨论此事。现在和解金额已定，与上庭审判相比，这对Meta来说是多大的解脱？

segments.en: Well, against what Meta said was its worst case scenario of 1.4 trillion, which would be every single count and accusation met with both of their penalty. $16.7 billion is low. And so clearly,
segments.zh: 嗯，相对于Meta所称的最坏情况1.4万亿美元——即每一项指控和诉讼都判罚——167亿美元算是低的。所以很明显，

segments.en: the stock reacting as it is in the last moment to pre-market de-risk, it removes that overhang.
segments.zh: 股价在盘前对此反应，消除了这一不确定性。

segments.en: But again, it was meta that had calculated that penalty. The states themselves had said that whatever the outcome of the trial where it was an advisory jury and B for the judge to decide, the penalties
segments.zh: 但再次强调，这是Meta自己计算的罚金。各州曾表示，无论审判结果如何——无论是咨询陪审团还是由法官决定——罚金

segments.en: would get nowhere near that. There would be in the hundreds of billions of dollars potentially.
segments.zh: 都不会接近那个数字。可能会达到数千亿美元。

segments.en: One thing is just against history. You remember think about 2019 when Meta settled with the FTC on a privacy issue. That was $5 billion. It's had prior settlements in various piece of
segments.zh: 回顾历史，2019年Meta与FTC就隐私问题达成和解，金额为50亿美元。此前也有过数十亿美元级别的诉讼和解。

segments.en: litigation in the low single digit billion. So this is still pretty significant number, Danny.
segments.zh: 所以这仍然是一个相当大的数字，Danny。

segments.en: And Ed, the states weren't just asking for money. They were also asking for changes on how meta operates.
segments.zh: Ed，各州不仅要求金钱赔偿，还要求Meta改变运营方式。
